Notes on Maria Eden by zaira@loverslab.com

[pagebreak]

In Maria Eden, there is no MCM menu. If you want to configure things, you will need to edit configuration files. There are the following files under Data/SKSE/Plugins/StorageUtilData MariaHotkeys.json Here you will find the most important hotkeys. The names are self-explanatory. The corresponding codes can be found at https://www.creationkit.com/index.php?title=Input_Script#DXScanCodes For all other configuration files, there are in-game menus. [pagebreak] Outfits All Maria mods heavily rely on outfits. Maria Eden brings an outfit manager with it. There are some fixed categories for outfits. Outfits can be created, copied, modified, and deleted through the outfit manager. SlaveTats are treated as part of the outfits. If you start the outfit manager, adjust your outfit, and press Escape to end the outfit manager or Return to save the current outfit. [pagebreak] Poses Many Maria mods use poses. There is a large set of predefined poses. Some of them require ZAP 8. You can use your own poses or link poses to hotkeys. Details can be found at Data/SKSE/Plugins/StorageUtilData int MariaIdleIDs.txt. Based on the IDs, Maria mods identify the current player pose - for example, ID 1 is the "Kneeling" pose. If you enter more than one animation for an ID, one will be chosen randomly. [pagebreak] Locations Maria Eden quests often rely on locations. There are many predefined locations, but you can also define your own locations. [pagebreak] NPC Management Maria Eden offers a comprehensive arsenal of tools to adjust NPCs in the ongoing game. If you want to permanently assign an outfit to an NPC, add the NPC to the group of managed NPCs. These assignments are permanent, so even if you start a new game, the outfits will remain.

The Life of Succubi by Molag Bal's First Slave

[pagebreak]

The Succubus

A succubus is a creature of lust and sexual magic.

It is perceived by most mortal creatures as a terrible creature of the underworld.

Succubi are immortal but not invulnerable. They possess only limited physical strength but can fly short distances.

Their minds are completely consumed by an insatiable desire for sex, and they are only capable of rational thought for a very short time after an orgasm.

The transformation into a succubus is irreversible.

[pagebreak]

Service

Like every creature of Coldharbour, succubi serve the lust of Molag Bal and are regularly summoned by their master for sex.

All succubi serve another immortal being besides Molag Bal.

The fate of a succubus is directly tied to its master. Their masters can enslave them through a magical bond of life energy.

In Coldharbour, succubi are considered the lowest of all creatures and must submit to the will of all other creatures.

[pagebreak]

Life Energy

The life energy of a succubus diminishes and can only be replenished by the life energy of a mortal creature.

The orgasm of a victim triggered by a succubus drains the victim's life energy and transfers it to the succubus.

The victim cannot recognize the transfer, and weak victims can lose their lives in this way.

After a transfer, the victim is infatuated with the succubus for a short time.

With the help of skooma, the loss of life energy can be temporarily halted.

A succubus is immortal, but if its life energy is depleted, it falls into a trance. Only skooma or Molag Bal can revive it.

[pagebreak]

Form Shifting

Succubi are shape-shifters and can appear in human form.

Maintaining human form costs additional life energy, and the amount of energy a succubus can extract from its victims is reduced.

In human form, a succubus can use weapons and its true form remains hidden.

In its true form, sexual magic is the only weapon.

A collar can force a succubus to assume its human form.

[pagebreak]

Magic

A succubus possesses powerful sexual magic. It can compel victims to have sex with it, with each other, and to masturbate.

Mortal creatures cannot resist the magic.

Victims of sexual magic experience intense love towards the succubus for a short time and protect it in combat.

If the succubus leaves the vicinity of the victim during this time, the victim remains infatuated.

The infatuation can escalate to obsession. In the final stage, a victim may take its own life out of despair if separated from the succubus for too long.

The infatuation makes the victim blind to the succubus's true form.

A succubus can compel all mortal creatures within a small radius to engage in a sexual orgy.

When using sexual magic, all mortal creatures in the succubus's vicinity are temporarily pacified.

Only a few immortal beings are sensitive to sexual magic, and a transfer of life energy does not occur. However, sex with an immortal being can trigger the state of infatuation in them.
